items.name: Lithium nickel manganese cobalt oxide
items.summary: Reference baseline. The chemistry the EU due-diligence list was written around: its highest-harm inputs, cobalt and nickel, are both covered.

use_cases.scope_basis: EV battery under Art. 3(1)(14); passport under Art. 77(1)

values.claim: EV batteries need a passport from 18 Feb 2027 (Art. 77(1))

items.name: Lithium iron phosphate
items.summary: Removes cobalt and nickel but keeps lithium, graphite and copper, and adds phosphate and iron, which are outside the EU due-diligence list. Cathode and anode production is concentrated in China.

use_cases.scope_basis: EV battery under Art. 3(1)(14); passport under Art. 77(1)

values.claim: EV batteries need a passport from 18 Feb 2027 (Art. 77(1))
Stationary storage is an industrial battery; industrial batteries > 2 kWh need a passport

use_cases.scope_basis: Backup batteries > 2 kWh are industrial batteries; ≤ 2 kWh units fall outside the passport

values.claim: Data-centre backup above 2 kWh is an industrial battery in passport scope

items.name: Lithium manganese iron phosphate
items.summary: LFP plus manganese. The manganese-sulphate chain is outside the EU due-diligence list, has no assurance scheme, and has documented harm at both mining and refining.

use_cases.scope_basis: EV battery under Art. 3(1)(14); passport under Art. 77(1)

values.claim: EV batteries need a passport from 18 Feb 2027 (Art. 77(1))

items.name: Vanadium redox flow battery
items.summary: Energy stored in vanadium electrolyte in external tanks. Vanadium is outside the EU due-diligence list, so the passport's sourcing field would cover none of its inputs.

use_cases.scope_basis: Battery with external storage (Art. 3(1)(1), 3(1)(8)); industrial battery > 2 kWh. Not a 'stationary battery energy storage system' (internal storage required)

values.claim: A battery 'having internal or external storage' is a battery; VRFB stores energy in external electrolyte tanks

use_cases.confidence_reason: Reading of T1 text: definition covers external storage; no guidance names flow batteries

items.name: Nickel-hydrogen
items.summary: Nickel hydroxide and nickel-alloy electrodes with hydrogen stored in a sealed cell. Nickel is on the EU due-diligence list; EnerVenue's nickel source is undisclosed.

values.claim: Stationary storage is an industrial battery; industrial batteries > 2 kWh need a passport

use_cases.scope_basis: Art. 1(5): batteries in equipment for essential security interests, arms, munitions, war material, or equipment sent into space

values.claim: The regulation does not apply to batteries in military equipment or equipment designed to be sent into space

items.name: Carbon-oxygen (reversible solid-oxide)
items.summary: Shadow passport: no product on market yet and cell materials undisclosed. Charging turns CO₂ into stored solid carbon; discharging recombines it with air oxygen in a reversible solid-oxide cell.

use_cases.scope_basis: Direct conversion of chemical energy with carbon in attached external tanks fits 'battery with external storage'; counter-argument: open-air oxygen and fuel-cell design, not addressed by the regulation

values.claim: Likely a battery with external storage under Art. 3(1)(1) and 3(1)(8)

use_cases.confidence_reason: Reading of T1 text, with a stated counter-argument
